rationale: All three blocking findings from code-review-final.json are resolved in commit b311ea19a. The fix-up diff is confined to one enum value in UsersView.tsx and the OverviewView test fixture/assertions, introducing no new high-risk surface (no security, public-API, data-loss or runtime-correctness exposure), so no narrow confirmation pass was warranted. Fix-up evidence is strong: npm run typecheck exit 0, npm run lint exit 0, and 22/22 tests passing across both affected files including the bare-render tests, which confirms beforeEach(mockReset) correctly restores the module factory's default implementation rather than leaving the hook undefined. CR-003's new test was additionally mutation-verified: with the guard rewritten to the naive kpis.tool_call_success_rate ? ... truthiness check, the two pre-existing Overview subtitle tests still passed while the new test failed, proving it pins the intended counter-based semantics rather than merely restating current output. An independently launched /code-review pass over the same branch reported no correctness defects and raised only the ColumnType declaration (CR-001, fixed here) and the out-of-scope Repositories inconsistency, corroborating this round. The 4 deferred findings from the final round remain deferred and unchanged; the most user-visible of them - Repositories, branch rows and session detail still rendering 0.00% at a zero denominator - is a scope boundary the human confirmed when approving the plan, and is worth naming in the MR description for the reviewer.
